dataset: DeepCrack (official test split, 237 images, pixel masks)
protocol: option (a): trained on the DeepCrack train split (contains cracks), 200/50 train/calib after anomalib moved ~50 normals into its test set; maps scored at ground-truth resolution; mu/delta from 50 held-out unlabeled calib maps; fixed 0.5 after standardization; seed 0
source: run on Google Colab T4, 2026-08-01, anomalib 1.1.1
note: The fixed-0.5 MIoU values are an artifact of applying the mean-threshold protocol to smooth distance-based score maps (recall ~0.95, precision ~0.1): the protocol was designed for sparse reconstruction-error maps. AUROC/AP are the valid cross-method numbers from this run. Do not put the MIoU column in a comparison table without per-method threshold handling.
